name: suggest-improvement
description: A customer suggests a change to something that exists. The worker collects product and detail and raises a Suggest Improvement ticket.

turns.say: It would be easier if the intake form remembered the product I picked last time instead of starting blank.
I'm Sam Ortiz, sam.ortiz@lakeview-eap.example, Lakeview EAP. It's in EAPx Cloud, on the Online Intake form. We'd like the Product field to default to the last choice.
Yes, please raise it with the team.
